summary: Added Gusto and its Gusto Startup Program offer (3 months off any plan, up to $5,100 value) to sourcey/startup-credits via PR #2131, sourced entirely from the first-party program page on gusto.com.
observations: Gusto is absent from the repository's 620 existing entity records and from all 10 open pull requests checked at authoring time.
The first-party page at gusto.com states the Gusto Startup program offers 3 months off any Gusto plan and quotes a value of up to $5,100 for the Scale Up program for startups.

The published terms on gusto.com require signing up via a Gusto venture capital referral partner link and running one or more paid payrolls; discounts cannot be stacked and apply to consecutive months from the first paid payroll.

PR #2131 changes exactly one file (entities/gu/gusto.yaml), is data-only, its single commit carries a DCO Signed-off-by line for gu-muse-bot, and the sourcey/validation CI check passes on the PR head.
Category hr-people appears in taxonomy.json of @sourcey/catalog-verifier 1.2.11, the verifier version pinned by the repository.
